question: For alien data, how many of the top 10 states by alien population have a higher percentage of friendly aliens than hostile aliens, with an average alien age exceeding 200?
sql:
WITH top10_states AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM alien_data
    GROUP BY state
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
state_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        COUNT(*) as total_population,
        SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as friendly_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hostile_count,
        AVG(age) as avg_age
    FROM alien_data
    GROUP BY state
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as count_of_states
FROM state_stats s
WHERE s.state IN (SELECT state FROM top10_states)
  AND 1.0 * s.friendly_count / s.total_population > 1.0 * s.hostile_count / s.total_population
  AND s.avg_age > 200
